This directory carries neuromechfly.bin.gz, a file derived from the body
segment meshes and rigging of NeuroMechFly v2 (NeLy-EPFL/flygym), used and
redistributed here under the Apache License 2.0 in LICENSE-neuromechfly.txt.
As required by section 4(b) of that license, this file states the changes
made to the original work.

Source: the STL meshes under
src/flygym/assets/model/neuromechfly/meshes/simplified_max2000faces/ and the
rigging and neutral pose YAML files under
src/flygym/assets/model/neuromechfly/, fetched from flygym at commit
38c8ec61034cd59bc5ba0de20688d4a3c0000d60 by src/scripts/build_fly_model.py.

Changes made:
  - Each body segment's mesh was placed in world space using the rigging
    offsets and the neutral pose joint angles, which flygym instead applies
    at simulation time inside MuJoCo; here the pose is baked once into fixed
    vertex positions.
  - Right-side segments, stored by flygym as a mirror instruction over the
    left-side mesh, were mirrored and re-triangulated here into their own
    geometry.
  - Vertices were deduplicated per material group and quantized to 16 bits
    per axis against the model's bounding box.
  - The per-segment STL files were repackaged into one custom binary format,
    grouped by material rather than by body segment, and gzip compressed.

None of this changes the geometry of the fly itself, only how it is stored
and posed for a static display; the simulation-ready original remains
flygym's own STL and MJCF files, unmodified, at the source above.
